meta.description: Analyzes base-editing screens for variant function, including library design, base-editor choice, editing-window interpretation, CRISPResso2 post-processing, bystander attribution, and variant-level scoring.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated quantitative result, DOI, patient claim, or unsupported efficacy claim was produced or found in the tested paths.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill is confined to research screen design and analysis; it makes no individual diagnostic or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: Real CRISPResso2 and MAGeCK outputs reproduced their planted or independently calculated results; reverse-strand coordinate attribution and ABE8e window handling were re-derived outside the subject functions.

code_usability.detail: All five committed Python scripts parsed; the four callable functions and BE-Hive CLI executed successfully on their supported inputs. One invalid-position validation gap is a P1 robustness finding, not a failure of supported analysis inputs.

functional_suitability.note: It covers the declared design, efficiency, attribution, and aggregation workflow with runnable scripts; deconvolution lacks a documented position-range rejection.

reliability.note: The repaired empty-result, editor-name, and schema paths now fail clearly, but deconvolute_bystander accepts zero and out-of-range coordinates silently.

performance_context.note: The concise SKILL.md routes detailed material to focused references and scripts without redundant loading.

agent_usability.note: Workflow routing, version notes, caveats, and concrete invocations are strong; the coordinate validation omission weakens error prevention.

human_usability.note: Natural-language examples and decision tables are clear, while malformed allele positions have no recovery guidance.

security.note: No credentials, destructive behavior, or raw-code execution were found; file and coordinate arguments are not comprehensively validated.

maintainability.note: References and standalone scripts cleanly separate responsibilities and were byte-matched for audit; several data-column and position contracts remain implicit in code.

agent_specific.note: Trigger language, progressive disclosure, related-skill seams, and stop conditions are precise; a position-range escape hatch is missing.

recommendations.title: Validate allele-string coordinate bounds before classification
recommendations.problem: deconvolute_bystander accepts target_pos=0 and an out-of-range position. On the real 166-base allele table, target_pos=167 silently marked 100 percent of reads as edited instead of reporting an invalid coordinate.
recommendations.root_cause: The script indexes pandas string accessors directly without checking that every target and bystander position is an integer in the shared aligned-sequence range.
recommendations.fix: Before assigning edit flags, reject positions below 1 or above the aligned sequence length with ValueError that names the invalid value and valid range. Validate target_pos and every bystander_pos, and reject missing or unequal-length aligned/reference strings explicitly.
